content.name: COOPER OAK
content.question: How should a workflow know which specialist must act next?
content.hypothesis: Make capability, provider, inputs, outputs and gates explicit before mutation.
content.evidence: The local contract rejects missing visual providers, seals route history and keeps UI mutation closed until required capability work exists.
content.next: Publish a clear case, then learn whether the contract is useful outside this profile experiment.

variants.name: BRANCH REGISTER
variants.thesis: A branching Oak grid turns growth into a strict editorial register.
variants.risk: Can drift into an environmental or institutional logo if the type relationship is weak.

variants.name: COUNTERFORM CANOPY
variants.thesis: One forest field is cut into an Oak; negative space carries the identity.
variants.risk: Can become a temporary app icon or overpower the evidence copy.

variants.name: RING LEDGER
variants.thesis: Stepped growth rings bind identity, unfinished history and evidence.
variants.risk: Can read as a technical diagram or generic data motif without the Oak trunk.
